features.title: Core Storage & Data Engine
features.description: Binary compression persistence, typed domain models, and atomic state synchronization.

subFeatures.title: Compressed Binary State & Storage Engine
subFeatures.description: Zlib-deflated binary serialization with magic header verification for high-density persistence.
subFeatures.what: Atomic binary read/write pipeline (.what-is-it.bin) with checksum and fallback decompression.
subFeatures.why: Eliminates file bloat and enables instant zero-latency loads for multi-agent workflows.
subFeatures.how: Node.js zlib deflateSync (level 9) with atomic temporary file renaming.

subFeatures.title: Type-Safe Feature Spec & Contract Validation
subFeatures.description: Strict TypeScript interfaces for nested features, sub-features, user stories, and role actions.
subFeatures.what: Runtime JSON Schema and compile-time TypeScript models covering all project entities.
subFeatures.why: Guarantees structural validity across CLI, web dashboard, and AI agent interactions.
subFeatures.how: Exported JSON schema builder and TypeScript strict type definitions.

subFeatures.title: Atomic Multi-Process File Locking
subFeatures.description: Advisory file locking to prevent corrupted state when multiple background agents write concurrently.
subFeatures.what: Advisory file lock protocol with timeout, auto-retry, and stale lock eviction.
subFeatures.why: Multiple AI agents or background tasks writing simultaneously can race and corrupt state.
subFeatures.how: Implement file descriptor locking or lockfile mechanism before atomic rename.

roleActions.action: Load and inspect binary project memory state
Perform concurrent atomic writes safely without race conditions

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want binary compressed project memory so that large architectures load instantly with zero token bloat.
acceptanceCriteria: Binary files under 50KB for large repos

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want multi-process locking so that background subagents do not overwrite each other.

whatsMissing: Atomic lockfile protocol for concurrent multi-agent write operations
State migration engine for forward/backward binary schema compatibility
missingDetails.why: Safeguard binary integrity when multiple subagents run parallel write tasks.
missingDetails.how: Implement advisory file locking before write and add schema version upgrade hooks.

features.title: CLI Tooling & Automation Interface
features.description: Command line utilities, caveman token-efficient status formatting, and scratch cleanup.

subFeatures.title: CLI Command Suite & Terminal Dispatcher
subFeatures.description: Full CLI suite with init, status, task, feature, export, import, schema, and UI launchers.
subFeatures.what: Comprehensive command line interface with arguments parsing and colored output.
subFeatures.why: Enables seamless control by both humans in terminals and AI agents via shell execution.
subFeatures.how: Commander.js option definitions, picocolors output formatting, and process exit codes.

subFeatures.title: Caveman-Style Token-Efficient Status Formatter
subFeatures.description: Concise, high-density terminal status output optimized for LLM token efficiency.
subFeatures.what: Formatted UGG/GRR caveman status highlighting overall progress, features, and missing gaps.
subFeatures.why: Minimizes LLM prompt token consumption while communicating maximum actionable context.
subFeatures.how: Custom string templater with color-coded ANSI glyphs and priority filters.

subFeatures.title: Automatic Scratch State Cleaner on Import
subFeatures.description: Automatically cleans up temporary scratch state JSON files and folders after binary update.
subFeatures.what: Unlinks temporary scratch json files and deletes empty scratch directories on successful import.
subFeatures.why: Prevents workspace clutter and prevents agents from reading stale temporary files.
subFeatures.how: File unlink hook with parent directory emptiness check in the CLI import action.

subFeatures.title: Interactive Feature & Milestone CLI Prompt Wizard
subFeatures.description: Interactive terminal prompts with tab completion for scoping features and sub-features.
subFeatures.what: Terminal interactive questionnaire for guiding developers through feature gap definitions.
subFeatures.why: Accelerates feature creation for developers who prefer interactive terminal guidance.
subFeatures.how: Integrate @clack/prompts or enquirer for interactive fuzzy selection and validation.

roleActions.action: Query concise caveman status with sub-features and gaps
Import state and automatically clean temporary scratch files
Launch interactive terminal wizard to define features and gaps

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want a concise caveman CLI status so that my AI coding assistant reads minimal tokens while staying oriented.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes feature progress and planned gaps

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want scratch state files to be deleted after import so that my repository remains clean.
acceptanceCriteria: Scratch json file unlinked upon import

whatsMissing: Interactive feature scoping wizard with tab auto-completion
Background daemon mode with real-time file change notifications
missingDetails.why: Provide an intuitive interactive setup experience for terminal-heavy developers.
missingDetails.how: Add Clack/Enquirer prompts and integrate an optional background fs.watch daemon.

features.title: Visual Dashboard & Spec Explorer
features.description: Interactive web dashboard, feature spec viewer, SVG flow graph canvas, and design system inspector.

subFeatures.title: Feature Spec & Architecture Explorer
subFeatures.description: Rich view displaying main features, nested sub-features with 4 W's, user stories, role actions, and planned gaps.
subFeatures.what: Interactive dashboard replacing flat task lists with deep architectural feature cards and gap summaries.
subFeatures.why: Gives humans and agents total clarity on what capabilities exist, who uses them, and what is missing.
subFeatures.how: React components with Tailwind CSS cards, filter bars, status pills, and expandable 4 W drawers.

subFeatures.title: Interactive SVG Node Graph & Wireframe Canvas
subFeatures.description: Visual React Flow canvas rendering desktop, mobile, and modal frames connected to actor roles.
subFeatures.what: Multi-screen UI topology visualization with custom frame renderers and edge connectors.
subFeatures.why: Allows visual verification of user journeys, design guidelines, and screen layouts.
subFeatures.how: @xyflow/react custom node implementations (DesktopFrameNode, MobileFrameNode, ModalFrameNode, ActorNode).

subFeatures.title: Design System & Component Specs Drawer
subFeatures.description: Right-rail sliding inspector detailing typography, color tokens, responsive breakpoints, and WCAG accessibility.
subFeatures.what: Detailed sliding inspector presenting UI guidelines, state specs (empty, loading, error), and layout blocks.
subFeatures.why: Provides full UI design system specs for any selected screen node.
subFeatures.how: Collapsible slide-over drawer triggered by node selection with tabbed specs and JSON inspector.

subFeatures.title: Dark/Light Theme Switcher & Mobile Gestures
subFeatures.description: Theme preference toggle and responsive mobile touch gestures (pinch-zoom, swipe tabs).
subFeatures.what: Persistent theme switching and mobile touch gesture support for the visual canvas.
subFeatures.why: Enhances usability on mobile devices and supports user accessibility preferences.
subFeatures.how: Tailwind dark class toggle with CSS variables and touch event handlers on the canvas viewport.

roleActions.action: Browse project features, sub-features, and missing planned gaps
Inspect interactive SVG user flow graph and screen wireframes
Toggle between dark and light themes or use touch gestures on mobile

userStories.story: As a User, I want to explore feature specs and missing gaps so that I understand product capabilities without reading raw code.
acceptanceCriteria: Search and filter by category or status

userStories.story: As a User, I want to inspect screen wireframes and design system rules so that UI components maintain visual consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: Drawer shows typography, colors, and accessibility specs

whatsMissing: Light / Dark theme toggle with system preference auto-detection
Mobile touch gesture gestures and canvas minimap zoom-to-fit toggle
missingDetails.why: Provide high-grade accessibility across diverse screen sizes and lighting environments.
missingDetails.how: Add theme context provider and configure React Flow touch gesture handlers.

features.title: Data Flow & Real-Time Synchronization
features.description: Embedded HTTP server, Server-Sent Events (SSE) live updates, and resilient state synchronization.

subFeatures.title: Embedded Micro-Server & Static Asset Server
subFeatures.description: Zero-dependency Node HTTP micro-server serving pre-bundled SPA assets and REST endpoints.
subFeatures.what: Local web server mounted on port 3456 serving the visual viewer without external runtime dependencies.
subFeatures.why: Enables instant web dashboard launching with a single npx command without complex server infrastructure.
subFeatures.how: Node.js http module with MIME type resolution and gzip stream support.

subFeatures.title: Live Server-Sent Events (SSE) Broadcast Pipeline
subFeatures.description: Push-based SSE channel streaming instantaneous state mutations directly to connected browser clients.
subFeatures.what: Real-time broadcast mechanism pushing updated project state on every CLI mutation.
subFeatures.why: Eliminates manual browser refresh and gives developers immediate feedback as AI agents work.
subFeatures.how: text/event-stream response stream with keep-alive heartbeat and reconnection support.

subFeatures.title: Resilient SSE Reconnection with Exponential Backoff
subFeatures.description: Client-side event source reconnect handler with exponential backoff and offline visual banners.
subFeatures.what: Robust client-side SSE reconnect protocol with visual disconnection banner and automatic retry.
subFeatures.why: Prevents broken UI state when server restarts or terminal process pauses.
subFeatures.how: Wrap EventSource with reconnection backoff timer and toast notifications.

roleActions.action: Stream live updates to connected browsers when agents modify tasks or features
Automatically reconnect to server if terminal restarts without losing view state

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want instant live updates in my open browser so that I watch my agent complete work in real time.

whatsMissing: Exponential backoff reconnection interceptor for client EventSource
Offline fallback caching when server connection is lost
missingDetails.why: Ensure seamless browser experience even if developer stops and restarts the CLI server.
missingDetails.how: Implement exponential backoff in App.tsx EventSource listener with state persistence.

features.title: Verification, Docs & Multi-Agent Protocols
features.description: Multi-agent skill installation, synchronized markdown documentation, and automated test suites.

subFeatures.title: Multi-Agent Rules & Skill Generator
subFeatures.description: Generates and installs SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules across all major IDE agents.
subFeatures.what: Universal agent onboarding rules installer establishing project memory protocol.
subFeatures.why: Ensures AI coding assistants (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code) automatically follow live memory protocols.
subFeatures.how: File templating with project-specific path injection and global config directory discovery.

subFeatures.title: Human-Readable Markdown Overview Mirror
subFeatures.description: Self-regenerating WHAT_IS_IT.md documentation mirror synchronized with binary state.
subFeatures.what: Formatted markdown document with progress bars, feature tables, and user flow links.
subFeatures.why: Allows repository visitors on GitHub to inspect live architecture and progress without running the CLI.
subFeatures.how: Automated markdown generator invoked on every binary write.

subFeatures.title: Comprehensive Automated Unit & Integration Tests
subFeatures.description: Vitest test suite covering binary persistence, schema validation, scanner synthesis, and CLI actions.
subFeatures.what: Automated test suite validating storage decompression, integrity checks, and progress calculation.
subFeatures.why: Guarantees zero regressions across releases and package upgrades.
subFeatures.how: Vitest runner with temporary test directory fixtures and assertion helpers.

subFeatures.title: End-to-End Headless Visual Regression Tests
subFeatures.description: Playwright headless browser verification of React Flow graph rendering and drawer interactions.
subFeatures.what: Automated visual screenshot comparison and interaction tests for the web viewer.
subFeatures.why: Prevents subtle rendering glitches in SVG flow frames and custom node layouts.
subFeatures.how: Playwright test runner with Percy or pixelmatch snapshot assertions.

roleActions.action: Install project memory rules for Antigravity, Cursor, and Claude Code
Run automated unit and integration tests
Run headless visual regression tests on the web canvas

userStories.story: As a Developer, I want multi-agent rules installed automatically so that new AI agents immediately know the project memory protocol.
As a Developer, I want a synced WHAT_IS_IT.md mirror so that GitHub viewers can inspect live progress at a glance.

whatsMissing: Headless visual regression test suite for React Flow canvas and drawer
Continuous integration GitHub Actions workflow for automatic publish
missingDetails.why: Ensure web canvas rendering and UI wireframes never degrade across dependency updates.
missingDetails.how: Configure Playwright test runner and GitHub Actions CI workflow.

wiki.title: Architecture & System Overview
wiki.content:
## High-Level Topology

@shakthizen/what-is-it is a cli project built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, CLI. It contains 41 tracked files across 0 routes, 11 components, 0 services/APIs, and 10 core/CLI modules.

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      Client / UI Layer                      |
|   Routes: 0 discovered | Components: 11 discovered  |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   Services & Data Layer                     |
|   API Endpoints / Services: 0 discovered             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   Core Engine & CLI Layer                   |
|   Core / CLI Modules: 10 discovered               |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

## Feature Spec & Sub-Feature Architecture

This project tracks capabilities through a structured **Feature Spec Model**:
- **Main Features**: High-level modules and domains.
- **Sub-Features**: Granular capabilities with implementation status (`implemented`, `in_progress`, `missing`) and full 4 W's rationale (`what`, `why`, `how`, `where`, `when`).
- **Role-Based Actions**: Operational capabilities mapped per actor role (`Developer`, `User`, `Admin`, `Guest`).
- **User Stories**: Acceptance-criteria-driven requirements ensuring user empathy.
- **What's Missing & Planned Gaps**: Explicit callouts of architectural debt, planned reliability, and future milestones.

## Tech Stack Decisions

- **Project Category**: `CLI`
- **Primary Frameworks**: `React`, `Vite`, `Tailwind CSS`, `CLI`
- **Live Documentation**: `@shakthizen/what-is-it` compressed binary state & multi-agent skill.

## Directory Structure

```text
📁 bin
📁 scripts
📁 src
📁 src/cli
📁 src/core
📁 src/web
📁 src/web/components
📁 src/web/components/nodes
📁 test
```

wiki.title: UI Guidelines & Design System
wiki.content:
## Design Principles

1. **Visual Clarity First**: Use crisp vector wireframes, distinct typography scales, and generous whitespace.
2. **Immediate Feedback**: Micro-interactions, animated state transitions, and clear loading states.
3. **Actor-Role Empathy**: Customize interfaces specifically for the active user role.
4. **Resilient State Architecture**: Every interactive surface must account for empty, loading, error, and hydrated states.

## Color Palette Tokens

| Role / Intent | Hex Token | Visual Representation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Brand** | `#6366f1` (Indigo 500) | 🟣 Primary buttons, active tabs, focus rings |
| **Success / Done** | `#10b981` (Emerald 500) | 🟢 Implemented features, positive status indicators |
| **In Progress** | `#f59e0b` (Amber 500) | 🟡 Active execution, pending review badges |
| **Danger / Missing** | `#ef4444` (Rose 500) | 🔴 Missing capabilities, architectural gaps |
| **Dark Canvas** | `#090d16` (Slate 950) | ⬛ Deep obsidian base background |
| **Surface Card** | `#131b2e` (Slate 900) | 🪟 Frosted glass card containers |
| **Card Border** | `#1e293b` (Slate 800) | 📐 Subtle structural dividers |
| **Text Primary** | `#f8fafc` (Slate 50) | ⚪ Headings and primary titles |
| **Text Muted** | `#94a3b8` (Slate 400) | 🔘 Captions, secondary labels, timestamps |

## Typography Scale

- **Display**: `font-bold 32px / line-height 40px` — Hero headlines and landing value props.
- **H1 Heading**: `font-bold 24px / line-height 32px` — Page titles and section headers.
- **H2 Heading**: `font-semibold 18px / line-height 26px` — Card titles and group headers.
- **H3 Heading**: `font-medium 14px / line-height 20px` — Subheaders and table column titles.
- **Body Text**: `font-normal 14px / line-height 22px` — Primary content and descriptions.
- **Caption / Meta**: `font-normal 12px / line-height 16px` — Badges, secondary metadata, timestamps.
- **Monospace Code**: `font-mono 12px` — File paths, IDs, tokens, shell commands.

## Spacing & Layout Grid

- **Base Unit**: 4px / 8px scale (`0.5rem = 8px`, `1rem = 16px`, `1.5rem = 24px`, `2rem = 32px`).
- **Container Padding**: Desktop `p-6` (24px), Mobile `p-4` (16px).
- **Element Spacing**: Cards `gap-4` (16px), dense lists `gap-2` (8px).
- **Max Width**: Application canvas constrained to `max-w-7xl` with auto centering.

## Accessibility & WCAG 2.1 AA

- **Color Contrast**: All text must achieve >= 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
- **Keyboard Navigation**: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) must have visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2`).
- **ARIA Semantics**: Use proper semantic HTML, `aria-label` for icon buttons, and `role="dialog"` with focus trapping on modals.

## State Handling Patterns

- **Empty State**: Friendly illustration or icon, explanatory heading, and prominent action button to create first item.
- **Loading State**: Skeleton placeholders preserving layout dimensions (avoid jumping / layout shift).
- **Error State**: Inline dismissible alert banner with human-readable cause and "Retry" button.

wiki.title: Actor Roles & User Journeys
wiki.content:
## Identified Actors

- 👤 **Guest / Visitor**: Unauthenticated user exploring landing pages, feature specs, and architectural overviews.
- 🔑 **Authenticated User**: Signed-in member viewing live progress dashboards, interactive graphs, and documentation.
- 🛠️ **Developer / AI Agent**: Pair programmer running CLI status, marking sub-features done, and maintaining live memory.
- 🛡️ **Administrator**: Project lead inspecting missing gaps, planning roadmap milestones, and auditing reliability.

## Primary User Flow

```text
[Guest]     --> (Visits App)        --> [Landing / Quickstart]
                                              |
                                              v (Selects Spec Explorer)
[User]      --> [Feature Spec Explorer] <---> [Interactive Visual Graph]
                     ^                                |
                     |                                v
[Developer] --> [CLI / Live Memory]             [Design Drawer]
```
